description: This file contains utility functions used internally by the Leaflet mapping library, including object manipulation, function binding, ID stamping, throttling, number wrapping, string trimming, templating, and request animation frame handling.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Merges properties from source objects into a destination object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new object with the specified prototype, polyfilled if native Object.create is unavailable.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Returns a function bound to a specific context and optional arguments.

methods.name: stamp
methods.description: Assigns or retrieves a unique ID for an object.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Returns a throttled version of a function that executes at most once per specified time interval.

methods.name: wrapNum
methods.description: Returns a number wrapped within a specified range, optionally including the max value.

methods.name: falseFn
methods.description: Returns a function that always returns false.

methods.name: formatNum
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string, polyfilled if necessary.

methods.name: splitWords
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of words after trimming.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Merges options into an object's options property.

methods.name: getParamString
methods.description: Converts an object into a URL parameter string.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Performs simple string templating with placeholders.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is an array, polyfilled if necessary.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of an element in an array.

methods.name: requestAnimFrame
methods.description: Schedules a function to run on the next repaint, with fallbacks.

methods.name: cancelAnimFrame
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled animation frame callback.
